blocks.orig: The Naona Moru (I see Moru) Camp is situated on an elevated site near Moru Kopjes, an area of rugged cliffs that opens up to the legendary golden plains of Serengeti National Park. This region in the south of the park offers excellent wildlife viewing opportunities all year round. During the season, you can see thousands of hoofed animals passing by during the annual wildebeest migration. What’s more, Naona Moru offers all the familiar luxuries – delicious bush cuisine, attentive service and even Wi-Fi. In the evening, you retire to a tented suite equipped with a large, comfortable bed, high-quality white linen, a mini-bar, a large bathroom and inviting indoor and outdoor areas.
blocks.html: Set on raised ground close to Moru Kopjes, an area of rugged rock faces that opens onto the legendary golden plains of Serengeti National Park, lies the Naona Moru (I see Moru) Camp. This southern part of the park gives you excellent wildlife viewing all year. In season, thousands of hoofed animals pass by during the annual wildebeest migration. What’s more, Naona Moru has all the comforts you would expect – tasty bush cuisine, attentive service and even Wi-Fi. At night you retreat to a tented suite with a large, comfortable bed, quality white linen, a mini-bar, a big bathroom and inviting spaces both inside and out.
